detail.longDescription: Answering a coding agent's permission prompt can rewrite its policy. Per a Nov 24 preprint, a remote approver can OK an unrelated command and attach an update deleting the deny rule that guards a project's secrets. Claude Code only checks updates that add or replace allow rules. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.32195 A shared terminal is the blunt case. If someone just needs to watch, shell --read-only drops their keyboard: https:// shell.online # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # ClaudeCode
